definitions: The process or result of making something into a particular form.
A performance or interpretation of a dramatic role or piece of music.
A layer of plaster or cement applied to an external wall.
The processing of animal fat by melting it down to clarify it.
examples: The rendering of the document took several hours.
Her rendering of the song was breathtaking.
The old house needed new rendering.
The rendering of lard was a common practice.
